Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Blossom-Clad Werewolf, causing you to draw a card.

222-527-728-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.

Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

240-4068-5470-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-4068-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-4068-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1169-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4875-5256.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

Repeat.

When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Repeat.

2837-3490-4289-7075.description:

Repeat.

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.

Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.

Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nykthos.
Repeat.
